description: This file contains unit tests for the GatewayMapperImpl class, verifying its behavior in mapping devices to gateways based on registration data and last known gateway info. It uses Mockito for mocking dependencies and JUnit for assertions.

classes.name: GatewayMapperImplTest
classes.description: Unit test class for GatewayMapperImpl, testing device-to-gateway mapping logic.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes mocks and the GatewayMapperImpl instance before each test.

methods.name: testGetMappedGatewayDeviceUsingDeviceWithNoVia
methods.description: Verifies that getMappedGatewayDevice returns the device ID when no 'via' entry exists.

methods.name: testGetMappedGatewayDeviceUsingDeviceWithMappedGateway
methods.description: Verifies that getMappedGatewayDevice returns an existing gateway from 'via' or last known gateway.

methods.name: testGetMappedGatewayDeviceReturningSingleDefinedViaGateway
methods.description: Verifies that when only one gateway is present in 'via', it is returned, even if getLastKnownGatewayForDevice returns 404.

methods.name: testGetMappedGatewayDeviceFailureUsingMultiGatewayDevice
methods.description: Verifies that a failure occurs if multiple gateways are in 'via' but getLastKnownGatewayForDevice fails.

methods.name: testGetMappedGatewayDeviceFailureIfGatewayNotInVia
methods.description: Verifies failure if getLastKnownGatewayForDevice returns a gateway not listed in 'via'.

methods.name: testGetMappedGatewayDeviceFailureIfGetLastGatewayFailed
methods.description: Verifies that a failure occurs if getLastKnownGatewayForDevice throws an exception.
